name: Gnoam Sprecklesprocket
summary: Deep in the Deadmines, Gnoam Sprecklesprocket powers a plan to reach Gnomeregan. Shoni the Shilent seeks it for drilling machines that could breach the rock around the lost gnomish home.

sections.title: A Vital Power Source
sections.body: Sneed's shredder runs deep in the Defias stronghold. The goblin taskmaster Sneed pilots the machine, whose compact power core supplies energy for heavy logging and cutting blades. Its steady output makes the Gnoam Sprecklesprocket valuable salvage in the tunnels of Westfall.

sections.title: Breaching Gnomeregan
sections.body: In Stormwind City, the gnomish inventor Shoni the Shilent has chosen the Deadmines shredder for a larger effort. Gnomish forces seek to reclaim Gnomeregan from the troggs who overran it, but sealed underground approaches block the way. Shoni plans to power heavy gyrodrillmatic excavationators with the Sprecklesprocket. They could bore through the bedrock around the lost techno-city and open an unexpected route for an underground assault.

faq.answer: The Gnoam Sprecklesprocket is a high-output power supply taken from a goblin shredder deep in the Deadmines. It can run heavy underground drilling machines.

faq.q: Where does the Gnoam Sprecklesprocket come from?
faq.answer: The Gnoam Sprecklesprocket comes from Sneed's Shredder, an industrial lumber machine operated by the goblin taskmaster Sneed in the Deadmines lumber mills.

faq.q: Why does Shoni the Shilent need it?
faq.answer: Shoni the Shilent needs the sprocket to power gyrodrillmatic excavationators. The machines can bore through the rock around Gnomeregan, opening a route for gnomes aligned with the Alliance to assault the troggs.

faq.q: Is the sprocket goblin or gnomish technology?
faq.answer: The sprocket comes from a working goblin shredder in the Deadmines, and Shoni plans to use it in gnomish drilling machinery. No one says who first designed the component.

angles.text: As a gnome, each salvaged component brings you closer to drilling into your lost home and driving out the troggs.
As an engineer, you can see how this intact power supply could run the machinery needed to bore through Gnomeregan's underground rock barriers.
